Caching is a technique for storing the result of data fetching and other computations so that future requests for the same data can be served faster, without doing the work again. ## Enabling Cache Components You can enable Cache Components by adding the [`cacheComponents`](/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/cacheComponents) option to your Next config file: ```ts filename="next.config.ts" switcher import type { NextConfig } from 'next' const nextConfig: NextConfig = { cacheComponents: true, } export default nextConfig ``` ```js filename="next.config.js" switcher /** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */ const nextConfig = { cacheComponents: true, } module.exports = nextConfig ``` > **Good to know:** When Cache Components is enabled, `GET` Route Handlers follow the same prerendering model as pages.
